name: rallly
nodeVersionNeeded: 24 (package.json engines.node "24" + .npmrc engine-strict=true; system Node 22 is refused). Used v24.21.0 from nodejs.org, unpacked at /home/user/shard/work/node24
browserRevisionExpected: chromium 1208 / chromium_headless_shell 1208 / ffmpeg 1011 (ran on installed 1194 via shim dir)
install: git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/lukevella/rallly && cd rallly  # at the commit above
GOPATH=/home/user/shard/work/gopath GOBIN=/home/user/shard/work/bin go install github.com/axllent/mailpit@latest   # once; mailpit is the CI mail service
build: NEXT_PUBLIC_BASE_URL=http://localhost:$PORT pnpm turbo build:test --filter=@rallly/web   # from repo root, with the env below exported; 2m29s here

env.NEXT_PUBLIC_BASE_URL: http://localhost:3101   (BUILD-TIME: inlined into .next; must match PORT)

migrate: pnpm db:deploy   (repo root; = prisma migrate deploy in packages/database; reads DATABASE_URL)
appStart: next start --port $PORT   (webServer.command when CI=true; cwd apps/web; webServer.env adds __NEXT_PROCESSED_ENV=true)
baselineCommand: cd apps/web && pnpm exec playwright test --workers=1 --reporter=list

baseline.flakyNotes: One clean run (Playwright summary: 140 passed (8.2m)); wallSec includes next start boot. The machine was shared: load average 6-8 on 4 vCPU (other agents' builds/tests) and this scout's documenso `npm ci` ran during the last ~6 min. The server logs 'Failed to load pay wall pricing Error: STRIPE_SECRET_KEY must be set when billing is enabled' 150 times; harmless. `--reporter=list` replaces the CI reporters (github + html) only for readable counts.

unmanagedServices: mailpit (SMTP for the app + HTTP API read by the tests via MAILPIT_API_URL; OTP login codes, invite and RSVP mails)
hardcodedUrlsInTests: tests/webhooks-settings.spec.ts:219 fills the literal http://localhost:3000/hook into a form field (typed text, never fetched)
none that navigate: baseURL = http://localhost:${PORT || 3002} in playwright.config.ts:8-10; webhook receivers bind 127.0.0.1:0 (tests/webhooks.spec.ts:50, webhooks-settings.spec.ts:119)
authSetup: none global: no globalSetup, no setup project, no storageState. Each test logs in through the UI (packages/test-helpers/src/login.ts: email OTP read from mailpit, or password) or creates users directly with prisma (tests/test-utils.ts). Sessions are DB-backed (better-auth session rows).
notes: BUILD-TIME URL: NEXT_PUBLIC_BASE_URL is inlined into the build (the build-time value appears in 72 files under apps/web/.next, both server chunks and client static chunks). It drives better-auth baseURL and trustedOrigins (apps/web/src/lib/auth.ts:59,667-668) and absoluteUrl() links. N instances started from ONE build on different ports will all generate URLs and trust origins for the build-time port, so auth from any other port is expected to fail and redirects/links point at worker 0's app. Either build once per port or give every instance the same origin.
At build time `NODE_ENV=test next build` reads apps/web/.env.test (NEXT_PUBLIC_BASE_URL=http://localhost:3002, PORT=3002) unless the env already sets them; exported env wins.

The Playwright config loads apps/web/.env.test with dotenv (does not override existing env; 15 of 20 keys were injected here). At runtime webServer.env sets __NEXT_PROCESSED_ENV=true, so Next reads no .env file; DATABASE_URL, SMTP_* and SECRET_PASSWORD are read from process env at runtime (not inlined; checked).
CI=true is required: without it the webServer command is `rm -rf .next && next dev`, which deletes the production build and runs a dev server (and reuseExistingServer becomes true).

SHARED MAILPIT: 10 specs call deleteAllMessages() (e.g. authentication.spec.ts:26, otp-sign-up.spec.ts:24, email-invites.spec.ts:97) and captureOne() picks the newest unread mail for a recipient and marks it read. With N workers on one mailpit, one worker wipes or consumes another's OTP mail. Give each worker its own mailpit (distinct --smtp/--listen ports; SMTP_PORT goes to that worker's app, MAILPIT_API_URL to that worker's test process). Both are plain env vars.

Test processes import the prisma client from @rallly/database (tests/test-utils.ts and many specs) and write to the DB directly, using DATABASE_URL from the worker's env. The per-worker DATABASE_URL must be set in the worker before spec files load.
tests/house-keeping.spec.ts calls /api/house-keeping/* with CRON_SECRET: these delete inactive or deleted polls DB-wide. That is safe with one DB per worker but not with a shared one.
Two specs run in serial mode (email-invites.spec.ts:26, list-unsubscribe.spec.ts:22).

BROWSER SHIM: Playwright >= 1.57 expects chrome-linux64/chrome and chrome-headless-shell-linux64/chrome-headless-shell; revision 1194 ships chrome-linux/{chrome,headless_shell}. Plain directory symlinks (chromium_headless_shell-1208 -> /opt/pw-browsers/chromium_headless_shell-1194) fail with 'Executable doesn't exist'. experiments/recipes/make-pw-shim.sh <rev> builds real dirs of per-file symlinks and adds the renamed executable link. Chrome 141 (1194) passed the 1.58.1 suite.
Postgres 16.13 used; CI uses postgres:18-alpine. All migrations applied cleanly on 16.
pnpm 10 skips dependency build scripts (@prisma/engines, esbuild, sharp, ...); CI does the same, and nothing needed them.
Mailpit was built from source with the Go toolchain at /usr/local/go (go install fetched go1.26.8 and modules via proxy.golang.org); GitHub release downloads were not tried.
